description: Rules for the public weekly feed of new food brands (python -m src.pipeline build-feed, and /feed on the website). The public feed is a teaser for the paid weekly list: a few company-level entries per journal week, shown only after a delay. The full CSV is never published. See docs/PUBLIC_FEED.md. Nothing here changes a score.
_comment: Commercial settings (top_n_per_week, delay_weeks) are a business decision; the defaults are deliberately conservative (see DECISIONS.md D-300..). Content rules that protect privacy (company-level only, no applicant names, region only) are enforced in code and are not configurable here.
site_description: A weekly sample of newly filed UK food and drink brands owned by recently matched companies, from public UK trade mark and Companies House data.
_top_n_per_week_note: Entries shown per journal week, highest LaunchTrace Score first. Paying customers get every qualifying lead.
_delay_weeks_note: A journal week becomes public only once it is at least this many weeks older than the newest journal in the database (so with 1, the latest week stays private to customers until the next week has been processed). 0 publishes immediately.
_bands_note: An entry must be in bands_allowed AND at or above min_band. SUPPRESS is never published, whatever this says.
_max_weeks_in_index_note: How many of the most recent public weeks are listed on the index page and in feed.xml / rss.xml / feed.json. Older week pages are not built.
_reason_keys_allowed_note: The one-line reason shown per entry is the first of the lead's stored score reasons that was rendered from one of these scoring indicators (config/scoring.json) and that contains no applicant name, URL or email address. Indicators whose text can carry a website or web evidence are deliberately not listed. If none qualifies, fallback_reason is shown.
fallback_reason: New food trade mark filed by a UK company
_public_base_url_note: Absolute URL where the feed pages are published, ending in '/', used for links inside feed.xml, rss.xml and feed.json (feed readers need absolute links). Empty means SITE_URL + '/feed/' (the website's own /feed routes). Set it to the GitHub Pages address if you publish the static build there.
_cta_note: Path on SITE_URL for the call to action. The static build links to SITE_URL + cta_path; the app links to cta_path.
